note: Every constant carries its basis. 'documented' constants cite an opened source. 'derived' and 'measured' come from one profile of a 31 GB Windows machine over 30 minutes (2026-10-04) and are not benchmarks of the nodes. 'estimate' constants are assumptions to replace with the node's own heartbeat data after one week.

agentSession.note: One coding-agent CLI plus its MCP children. The top Claude processes held 0.31-0.37 GB each in the profile; children and tools are not separated.

headlessBrowser.note: About 4 browser processes at 0.175 GB each (regression of RAM used on browser process count in the profile).

linuxDesktopContainer.note: A container with a virtual display, a remote-desktop server and a browser profile.

windowsVm.note: Guest memory for a Windows virtual machine with a browser; requires Windows Pro for Hyper-V.

osAndServices.note: Services, Defender and memory compression on the profiled laptop.

langfuseStack.note: Langfuse's Docker Compose page recommends 4+ cores, 16 GiB RAM and 100+ GiB storage on one VM, without high availability.

monitoring.note: windows_exporter or Beszel agent, Uptime Kuma.

ragPerMillionChunks.note: About 4 bytes per dimension per vector at full precision; a vendor formula, not a co-run measurement.

freeFloorGb.note: Free-RAM floor used by the machine admission policy and the Windows safety margin.

odoo.note: Odoo's deployment documentation: workers = (CPU x 2) + 1, one worker serves about 6 concurrent users, about 150 MB per light worker and 1 GB per heavy worker, assuming 20% heavy requests. Postgres memory is an estimate because the documentation gives none.

qwen-image-fp8.name: Qwen-Image fp8 (ComfyUI)
qwen-image-fp8.note: Measured by the ComfyUI docs on a 24 GB card at 34-94 seconds per image.

wan22-ti2v-5b.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B video
wan22-ti2v-5b.note: README states at least 24 GB; ComfyUI offloading fits 8 GB at lower speed.

wan22-a14b.name: Wan 2.2 A14B video
wan22-a14b.note: README states at least 80 GB on a single GPU.

gpuTiers.class: 24 GB card (Arc Pro B60, or a used 24 GB card)
96 GB workstation card (RTX PRO 6000) or 128 GB unified memory (GB10, slower bandwidth)
128 GB unified memory (GB10) or rented cloud GPU
